items.title: Delta’s Amazon Wi-Fi At Risk Of Delay As Boeing-Lockheed Rocket Failure Destroys 40 Satellites
items.summary: Delta Air Lines' high-speed WiFi rollout plans have hit another potential hurdle following the in-flight failure of a United Launch Alliance (ULA) rocket in mid-November. The Vulcan rocket experienced what ULA is calling an 'anomaly' shortly after its launch on November 15th, resulting in the loss of its payload. In this instance, the payload was 40 Amazon satellites that would have supported its Leo internet network.
